Commission and ticket accounting does not affect book-cover placement, size, or cropping.
The source decision does not change the current or planned product name.
The per-mint reward accounting rule does not change email authentication or dashboard access behavior.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already records one ticket per non-promotional coded-referral mint, consistent with the source decision.
The reward count applies to resulting mints but does not change the Transak provider, payment flow, wallet provisioning, or lifecycle state.
